description.en: PLACEHOLDER: layered, pan-fried flatbread. Trial file for the recipe template.

safetyNote.en: PLACEHOLDER: dairy applies only if ghee or butter is used for layering.

prepNote.en: PLACEHOLDER: up to 4 cups, added as needed
PLACEHOLDER: for layering and pan-frying, no set amount

text.en: PLACEHOLDER: whisk the flour, salt and sugar. Add the water gradually until a sticky dough forms.
PLACEHOLDER: knead on a floured surface, working in the oil until the dough is soft.
PLACEHOLDER: roll each piece to an oval, spread with fat, dust with flour, roll up like a cinnamon roll and tuck the end.
PLACEHOLDER: roll each coil flat into a circle without over-stretching.
PLACEHOLDER: cook on an oiled hot pan until it bubbles, flip, brush with oil, flip again and cook until puffed and golden.
